title: I've started a business freelancing AI-generated music for game devs.
author: _stevencasteel_

comments.author: -RoopeSeta-
comments.body: Who would buy AI music if they can make their own with AI?

replies.author: _stevencasteel_
replies.body: Why would they pay anybody if they can make their own with AI?

replies.author: -RoopeSeta-
replies.body: Your target audience is indie devs with no money.

comments.author: SimmerDownnn
comments.body: Ew....  I don't want to be that guy, but I hope you never make money using Ai for this BS.

replies.author: _stevencasteel_
replies.body:
Then why are you in r/aigamedev?

Why would you say something so hurtful?

replies.author: SimmerDownnn
replies.body: Im keeping an eye on developing technologies and how people implement them. I don't wish anything against you personally, but you did open a bussiness, using an algorithm to make "A R T". In opening a bussiness you will have people like me who dont agree with your bussiness model. It's part of it. criticism is part of the game. Unless you want an echo chamber...

replies.author: _stevencasteel_
replies.body:
You said "I hope you never make money using AI".

Where is *that* coming from? Of course it was personal.
